COMPARISON: MRI from 2/12/2023
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 1.5 tesla.
MEDICATIONS:
Gadovist - 5 mL - Intravenous
FINDINGS:
Increased size of left temporal diffuse astrocytoma, now measuring approximately 4.2 x 3.8 x 3.6 cm (CC x AP x TR). IMPRESSION: 
Progressive enlargement of left temporal diffuse astrocytoma with associated mass effect. Continued surveillance recommended.
